summary: Implemented every stub in src/jinja2/filters.py, including the sync and async filter bodies and the missing helpers the FILTERS table needs (async variants of first, join, groupby, list, map, select, reject, selectattr, rejectattr, slice and sum, plus _min_or_max, prepare_map and select_or_reject). The last full-suite run did not reach test collection: tests/conftest.py imports jinja2, and src/jinja2/nodes.py line 80 uses PEP 701 nested f-string quotes that the 3.10 interpreter rejects, so the counts are unknown.
